title: Turbosmart All New Boost Tee Manual Boost Controller
description:
The All-New Boost Tee Manual Boost Controller from Turbosmart brings a sleeker, 33% smaller footprint to one of the most trusted manual boost controllers on the market. Precision-machined in Australia from high-grade brass and billet aluminum, the Boost Tee functions as a pneumatic bleed valve that manipulates reference signals to boost-based internal actuators or external wastegates—allowing you to safely increase manifold pressure 100% to 200% over base mechanical spring rates.

Engineered with Turbosmart’s proprietary Gate Feature, the controller delays the wastegate pressure signal until right before target boost, providing a significantly faster turbo spool and tighter low-end response. Adjustments are made in distinct, tactile steps via a proven detent system, while an anti-tamper locking mechanism ensures your set boost pressure remains locked in under intense vibration and track conditions.

#### KEY FEATURES

* Compact Design: 33% smaller and lighter than previous generations for easy mounting in tight engine bays.
* Proprietary Gate Feature: Minimizes wastegate creep for maximum low-end boost response and faster spool-up.
* Proven Detent Adjustment: Allows positive, incremental adjustments so you can dial in pressure with confidence.
* Anti-Tamper Locking System: Keeps setting adjustments secure once set.
* Universal Fitment: Works with all boost-based internal wastegate actuators and external wastegates.
* Billet Construction: Built from high-grade brass and anodized billet aluminum.
